biotools.summary: NuMIT is a software package implementing a null model-based non-linear normalisation procedure for comparing information decomposition across complex systems. It is implemented in MATLAB and provides practical implementations for systems with different statistics, demonstrated on synthetic models and human neuroimaging data.
